questions.answer: The bounded FamilySearch Scotland Births and Baptisms query for William Glasgow, 1595–1625, father George, returned 12 entries, all in father roles; none was a principal William child. Returned spelling variants included Glascow, Glassgow and Glasgo. The unrelated Glaincors result was not assigned to a Glasgow. This is coverage of a returned index set, not proof that George had no son William. The previously identified Thomas 1612 baptism is not transferred to William. Father 43% remains unchanged.
